prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Nootaikok, the benevolent friendly Inuit spirit dressed in black, who lives in water inside icebergs and guides hunters to seals [nootaikok-c01,c02,c03,c04]. COMPLETE REDRAW with a CLEARLY VISIBLE FRIENDLY HUMANLIKE FACE and ARCTIC BLACK SKIN/FUR CLOTHING.
ANATOMY: ONE dignified adult humanlike spirit with ONE normal head, TWO naturally brown eyes, TWO arms and TWO legs. A calm generous face with relaxed brow, gently intent eyes and soft benevolent closed-mouth expression; face turned slightly toward the seals while one eye contact invites trust. Face is LARGE and CLEAR, partly softly shadowed but never hidden, hollow, blank or frightening. Original respectful Arctic-humanlike appearance, no ethnic caricature, monster teeth, skull, exaggerated features, glowing eyes, antlers or fins. Humanlike rendition is editorial interpretation of a dressed spirit, not a historical portrait. Both ordinary bare hands visible with exactly five digits each, thumb plus four fingers, relaxed open offering palms. No grasping or clawing fingers.
CLOTHING: Fully opaque thick BLACK ARCTIC SKIN PARKA, stitched black fur ruff around hood with face aperture open wide, fitted heavy sleeves and close fur cuffs, separate black skin trousers and black skin boots. Black fur/hide is entirely matte and textured. The outfit is heavy practical Arctic clothing with hand-stitched seams, NOT a long friar robe, cape or wizard costume; NO flared sleeves, pointed hood, belted European coat, knitted cap or modern diving apparatus. All torso/arms/legs fully covered [nootaikok-c03].
MOMENT: Fully UNDERWATER INSIDE AN ICEBERG, Nootaikok makes a broad open-handed OFFERING/GUIDING gesture, directing THREE healthy ordinary seals swimming smoothly past the spirit toward a naturally open light shaft and Inuit hunters safely above the water [nootaikok-c01,c03,c04]. The other open hand is near chest, palm gently up, no threatening reach. Body makes a flowing forward turn, dense black fur/hide clothing suspended in ordinary water, kindness obvious on the lit face. This is an active supernatural helper in impossible submerged Arctic clothing, no harm or threat to viewer/seals.
POWER: Guiding and offering seals ONLY [nootaikok-c03,c04]. ALL ice walls STATIONARY and INTACT, an existing NATURAL ice passage. No ice parting, cracks, breaking, flying chunks, magical water current or destructive effects. Ordinary current moves tiny bubbles, particles and clothing. No light emitted by spirit, no aura or glowing eyes.
SCALE & CAMERA: Close low underwater camera, Nootaikok dominates LEFT TWO-THIRDS of square, lit face in upper-left large and readable at200px, both offering hands and thick black Arctic clothing clear. Seal stream at lower-right. Normal spirit humanlike size, no invented giant scale; perspective makes foreground subject large. Two distant Inuit hunters above opening remain small secondary.
LIGHT & WEATHER: ONE natural daylight shaft penetrates existing iceberg opening and lands plainly on the calm FACE and two brown eyes, then grazes black fur and seals. Strong natural rim light against deep black clothing, translucent glacier blue, actual bubbles/water caustics, no generic glow.
SURFACE: Heavy wet matte black hide, short black fur hood ruff/cuffs, hand-stitched seams, naturally humanlike face, clear dense ice with trapped bubbles, natural seal fur.
SETTING: Underwater within glacier/iceberg water [nootaikok-c01,c03]. At high background natural opening, TWO distant Inuit hunters wearing FUR-RUFFED SKIN PARKAS with hoods, one holding a traditional HARPOON; a narrow skin-covered KAYAK rests at floe edge. No thick European beards, knitted caps, rifles or European trappers. Hunters safely above water and secondary. Inuit clothing/harpoon/kayak are contextual editorial choices, not an asserted exact historical scene.
MOOD: BENEVOLENT and overwhelmingly majestic FRIENDLY GUARDIAN, protective generosity and dignified presence in glacier water. Awe from vast ice and close submerged spirit, never sinister, deathlike, angry or cute.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, watermark, aura, generic glow, neon outline, energy ribbons, floating runes, borrowed film/game/anime/comic designs, extra heads/eyes/limbs/digits, nudity, blood, injury, victim, magical ice movement or empty hood.
depicted_variant: Friendly humanlike black-Arctic-clad underwater spirit offering seals, face clearly visible in natural daylight

visual_requirements.description: Beneficial friendly spirit dressed in black; respectful editorial humanlike face with two eyes, heavy black Arctic skin/fur clothing rather than void robe
Guides or offers seals to hunters with open-handed gesture; no ice movement, breakage or invented magic

aura: No aura; documented spirit, habitat and action nootaikok-c03, nootaikok-c01, nootaikok-c02, nootaikok-c04.
artistic_choices: Humanlike adult face with two eyes, thick black skin/fur parka/trousers/boots and fur hood ruff are restrained editorial rendering of dressed friendly spirit c03, not specified historical iconography. The visible gentle face implements benevolence rather than death-wraith coding.
Natural existing iceberg channel and ordinary current only. No active ice manipulation inferred from domain. Offering hand gesture and swimming seals express c03/c04.

Two distant Inuit hunters in fur-ruffed skin parkas, traditional harpoon and narrow skin kayak provide respectful tradition context as editorial staging; no invented facial caricature or claim of exact historical apparel. Three seals are editorial count.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

rejected_attempts.reason: Self-reject after root source check: prompt asserted active ice-parting/dislodging ice magic unsupported by c01/c02. Ruling icebergs and guiding seals do not document destructive ice movement; regenerate with stationary natural channel and ordinary current only.

Keep: one spirit dressed in black (nootaikok-c03), in the water inside an iceberg/glacier (c01/c03), guiding seals toward hunters (c01/c03/c04). Keep the ice walls still, with no ice magic or breaking, and no aura or glow. Fix: (a) No void hood. Show a calm, dignified humanlike face, partly shadowed but clearly present, with two eyes and a benevolent expression turned toward the seals or the viewer, so it reads as a friendly guardian spirit. Make the black clothing a heavy hooded Arctic garment of black skin or fur (editorial), not a European friar's robe with flared sleeves and leather gloves. Nothing should read as the Grim Reaper, a Ringwraith or a Dementor. (b) If hunters are shown, they must read as Inuit hunters: fur-ruffed skin parkas and a harpoon, perhaps a kayak at the floe edge. Not bearded European trappers in knitted caps and belted coats. Keep them small and secondary. (c) Keep the majesty: the spirit large and close in the frame, a sweeping offering gesture, seals streaming past it toward the light, and one shaft of daylight through the ice falling on its face. No text.

visual_review.notes: Native1254 and200px inspected. Clearly present calm humanlike face, TWO brown eyes, relaxed benevolent closed-mouth expression under broad black fur hood ruff; no empty void/death-wraith coding. Heavy black skin/fur parka with fitted sleeves, separate black trousers and boots; two open offering hands with thumb plus four fingers each, two legs. Large foreground spirit entirely underwater without breathing gear guides three healthy seals. Natural daylight visibly lights face and seals; stationary intact ice, ordinary bubbles only. Two small secondary hunters wear fur-ruffed skin parkas, one harpoon and narrow kayak above floe edge, no knitted caps/European beards. Friendly Arctic guardian context remains clear at200, active generous sweeping offering gesture, no aura/text/ice magic or invented nonhuman traits. Seven Sangar checks pass for benevolent majestic interpretation.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and face, both-hand, legs/boots, seal and hunter crops. What works and answers r01: the void hood and friar robe are gone. One humanlike spirit with one head, a clearly visible face, two brown eyes and a closed mouth, in a heavy, matte, fully opaque black fur-and-skin parka with a black fur ruff, black trousers and black boots (dressed in black, nootaikok-c03). Two open offering hands, each a thumb plus four fingers, and two legs. It is fully underwater in a still blue ice channel inside an iceberg (c01/c03), with no ice magic, aura or text. Three anatomically normal seals swim past toward the opening (offers seals, leads hunters to seals, c03/c04). The hunters now wear fur-ruffed parkas, one holds a harpoon, and a skin-covered boat lies beside them. It still fails Uji Sangar #2 and #7, for the same reason idlirvirissong was rejected in 2079-r02. (1) The spirit now reads as an ordinary present-day Inuit man in a parka. The face is a photographic stock-portrait face with a casual, slightly smug half-smile and a raised brow, not a dignified spirit. There is no house painterly treatment, and nothing about the figure sets it apart from a man swimming with seals. At 200px the image reads as 'smiling man in a parka with seals under the ice', a pleasant wildlife or tourism photo, not an awe-inspiring guardian who rules the icebergs and glaciers (c01/c02). (2) The lighting is high-key and evenly bright: a sunny cyan scene with blue sky and puffs of cloud through the opening. That is cheerful, not the low-key, single-source majesty that §6.2 #5/#9 ask for, and §6.5 says benevolent beings must still be awe-inspiring. (3) Minor: the two hunters seem to stand knee-deep and waist-deep in open waves rather than on the floe edge, and the split above/below-water perspective is incoherent.

correction_notes: Keep: one spirit dressed in black (nootaikok-c03) with a clearly visible humanlike face and two eyes, heavy matte black skin/fur Arctic clothing, two open five-fingered hands in an offering gesture, in the water inside an iceberg/glacier (c01/c03), and seals streaming past toward the hunters (c03/c04). Keep the ice walls still, with no ice magic, aura, glow or text. Fix: (a) It must read as a spirit, not a man swimming. Paint it in the house painterly style, not as a photographic portrait. Give it an ageless, solemn, dignified face with a calm, steady, direct gaze and a closed mouth: kindly but grave, never a casual grin or smirk. Show it at ease in deep water where no person could be: no breath bubbles, the fur ruff drifting weightlessly, the body hanging upright and unmoving in the current as the master of this place. (b) Build majesty from framing and light, not invented anatomy. Use a tight, foreshortened, low camera so the figure looms close and fills the frame. Make the deep blue-black interior of the iceberg it rules (c01/c02) a low-key darkness. Let ONE shaft of daylight fall from a small, distant opening high above onto its face and hands. Have the seals rise out of the dark depths behind and around it and stream past its open hands toward the light, as if it is releasing them (offers seals, c03). No bright, sunny cyan scene, blue sky or cloud puffs. (c) Keep the Inuit hunters tiny and secondary: small figures on the edge of the ice floe at the far opening, in fur-ruffed parkas, with a harpoon and a kayak, standing on ice, not in open water.
